_what: Where each editor's identity card lives. Cards are DISTRIBUTED — one heteronym per institution — so this maps a name to a URL on another domain.
_convention: The path is NOT uniform and must not be guessed. Most sites use /who/<slug>/; vpcor.org uses /ayanna/, named for the heteronym rather than the question; machinemediation.org uses /who/ for the seven mantles collectively. Verified 2026-08-17: twelve of thirteen return 200. survivethedeletion.vercel.app/who/spellings/ returns 403 (Vercel deployment protection) and is recorded here as the known exception rather than dropped.
